mentions.name: Invoice parser for small businesses
mentions.description: This tool parses invoices for small businesses, processing invoice documents to extract their data. The author notes that integrating it will be challenging.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an invoice parser for small businesses to use. It's a fun project but the integration is going to be a bitch.
